rules.name: rrr-dcs-probe-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT derivative_type, opt_periodicity, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, ROUND(SUM(active_lots), 4) AS lots, ROUND(SUM(mtm_usd), 2) AS mtm_usd, ROUND(SUM(mkt_value_usd), 2) AS mkt_value_usd, MIN(maturity_date) AS first_maturity, MAX(maturity_date) AS last_maturity FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE SUBSTRING_INDEX(contract_number, '_', 1) = 'DCS' GROUP BY derivative_type, opt_periodicity

SELECT p.derivative_type, p.opt_periodicity, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, ROUND(SUM(p.active_lots)::numeric, 4) AS lots, ROUND(SUM(p.mtm_usd)::numeric, 2) AS mtm_usd, ROUND(SUM(p.mkt_value_usd)::numeric, 2) AS mkt_value_usd, MIN(p.maturity_date) AS first_maturity, MAX(p.maturity_date) AS last_maturity, MIN(p.contract_number) AS example_contract FROM opera.fn_client_statement_position_rows_v2( (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), CAST(:bu AS text), CAST(:valueDate AS date), CAST('["DCS"]' AS jsonb)) p GROUP BY p.derivative_type, p.opt_periodicity

SELECT upper(t.deal_status) AS deal_status, t.netting_status, COUNT(*) AS n_trades, MIN(s.maturity_date) AS first_maturity, MAX(s.maturity_date) AS last_maturity, MIN(s.derivative_type) AS example_type FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table t JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = t.business_unit AND s.security_id = t.security_id WHERE t.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND upper(split_part(t.contract_number, '_', 1)) = 'DCS' AND lower(t.deal_status) = 'live' AND (s.maturity_date IS NULL OR s.maturity_date >= :valueDate) GROUP BY 1, 2
